author: meldavy (fork by Co0p3r21)
name: MQTT
description: Publish machine state to an MQTT broker, receive control commands, and trigger Home Assistant automations via dashboard button. Wire-compatible with the de1app MQTT plugin.

Host.label: Broker host
Host.description: Hostname or IP of the MQTT broker. Empty disables the integration.

Port.label: Broker port
Port.description: MQTT broker port. 8883 for TLS, 1883 for plain TCP.

ClientId.label: Client ID
ClientId.description: MQTT client ID. Leave empty to use the auto-generated unique ID.

TopicPrefix.label: Topic prefix
TopicPrefix.description: Prefix for state and command topics. Leave empty to use de1plus/<unique id>.

EnableTls.label: Use TLS
EnableTls.description: Connect to the broker over TLS.

HaAutoDiscoveryEnable.label: Enable HA Auto-Discovery
HaAutoDiscoveryEnable.description: Publish Home Assistant MQTT discovery entities on broker connect.

ShowButton.label: Show dashboard button
ShowButton.description: Show a small button on the Streamline dashboard that publishes an MQTT event for Home Assistant.

ButtonLabel.label: Button label
ButtonLabel.description: Emoji or short text shown on the dashboard button (max 24 characters).

ButtonTile.label: Button tile
ButtonTile.description: Dashboard tile to place the button on: drink, dose, grind, or temperature.

ButtonSize.label: Button size
ButtonSize.description: Size of the button: small, medium, or large.
